_about: Criterion dictionary for tools/wem_lint.py — the controlled vocabulary and
allowlists the conformance lint measures the core interface layer against.
JSON, not YAML: the lint is stdlib-only by design (no PyYAML dependency) and
json is the only structured format the standard library parses. Keys starting
with an underscore are comments and are ignored by the loader.
Entity, Event, Item and Extrinsic, all of which the core now declares.
_allowed_imports: DR-COR-003/005 — the interface layer imports contracts only.
_typevar_roles: NFR-ORG-03 criterion 1 — a TypeVar names the role the type plays in the
contract, not the mechanism. Every name declared in src/wattleflow/core is
covered by this list; anything outside it is R-CORE-TYP-02 (WARNING).
_typevar_synonyms: NFR-ORG-03 criterion 6 — synonym collapsed to its canonical role.
Carried over from the YAML block but NOT yet consumed by any rule:
TypeVarRule tests membership in typevar_roles only. The lint reports this
key as R-CORE-CFG-01 on every run so the gap stays declared, never silent.
_typevar_tolerated: Known departures from the role vocabulary that the criterion tolerates:
reported as WARNING rather than ERROR until a DR renames them or admits
them to typevar_roles. Named after the effect on severity; the key was
renamed from the YAML block's original name on 2026-07-28.
UNRESOLVED CONFLICT: WattleType is listed here AND in typevar_forbidden,
where the in-force rule makes it an ERROR. The forbidden list wins today
because no DR has downgraded it; the conflict is surfaced as
R-CORE-CFG-01 rather than silently decided by the tool.
_exclude_modules: Infrastructure files inside the package directory that are not interface
modules. Every entry is a DECLARED blind spot: the lint emits R-CORE-EXC-01
INFO for each exclusion so the vector never hides one.
